proposedIdentity.organizationRelationship: Vaud home-care site of Senevita AG, presented as one Senevita Casa location with internal regional field teams.

evidence.title: Spitex pour la ville et la campagne devient Senevita Casa

conclusions.statement: The current public-facing name is Senevita Casa Vaud.
The official site identifies Senevita AG as the legal organization and headquarters identity.
conclusions.ambiguity: The reviewed pages do not identify a separately registered Vaud legal entity.

conclusions.statement: The Lia record corresponds to an actual Vaud home-care operating site with a Renens office, not merely the national Senevita organization.
The official team page presents regional field responsibilities inside one Vaud site; it does not establish separately identified Lia provider units.
conclusions.ambiguity: Operational or licensing boundaries beneath the Vaud site are not stated.

conclusions.statement: Senevita Casa succeeded the former Spitex pour la Ville et la Campagne brand on 1 July 2021 after that operation had been wholly owned by the Senevita group since 2016.

unresolved: Whether Senevita Casa Vaud has a separate cantonal authorization or legal registration beneath Senevita AG.
Whether any regional field teams should ever become distinct provider records; the current official identity evidence does not support that split.

recommendation.oneRecordDisposition: Keep one Senevita Casa Vaud provider identity for later review and link it to Senevita AG; do not split the internal regional team structure now.
reasoning: The official directory and site page consistently identify one Vaud home-care site in Renens.
The legal organization and the consumer-facing operating identity are distinct and should be represented by the existing organization/provider architecture.
